name: Age of Pirates
detailed_description: Are you ready for an incredible pirate adventure? Choose the ship you desire and embark on the journey. Dive into the ever-changing world and battle against various enemies and monsters. Continuously upgrade your ship and weapons. Experiment with the wildest combinations that offer limitless variations. Let's see whose weapon power will prove stronger: yours, the naval forces, other pirates, or the sea monsters pursuing you. Don't forget to collect a variety of treasures along the way.

short_description: Embark on an adventure as a pirate in the age of pirates. Battle enemies as you move from map to map. Upgrade your ship with new weapons and abilities. This Bullet Heaven Roguelike is for the cruelest pirates!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Swedish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 or better
  • Graphics: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: GTX 770 / Radeon 8950 HD or better
